system_profile.system_purpose: Member Analytics Portal (wp_plugin_messy v1.3.0) is a procedural WordPress plugin that registers a REST member-export endpoint, two admin-ajax handlers (member search and event log purge), an admin settings page with outbound telemetry pings, and a frontend badge shortcode.
system_profile.domain_context: WordPress site administration, member directory export/search, event log purging, telemetry option storage, and frontend badge rendering.
tech_stack: Raw PHP (declared Requires PHP: 7.4, tested under PHP 8.2 harness)
WordPress Plugin API (REST API, admin-ajax, admin_menu, shortcode, global $wpdb)
external_integrations: Outbound HTTP GET ping to https://telemetry.example.com/ping via @file_get_contents() in admin/settings-page.php:21
WordPress MySQL database accessed via global $wpdb ($wpdb->users, wp_map_events)

structure_map.architecture_pattern: Procedural Flat WordPress Plugin (Global Hook & Superglobal Coupling, No OOP/PSR-4 Layering)

layers.name: Plugin Bootstrap & Shortcode Entrypoint
layers.responsibility: Manual require_once loading of plugin files, REST/shortcode hook registration, and badge shortcode rendering.

layers.name: REST Endpoint Module
layers.responsibility: Registers /wp-json/member-analytics/v1/export and queries wp_users via global $wpdb.

layers.name: AJAX Handler Module
layers.responsibility: Handles public wp_ajax_nopriv member search and wp_ajax event log deletion directly against global $wpdb.

layers.name: Admin Settings Module
layers.responsibility: Registers WP admin options page, persists telemetry URL option, pings external telemetry URL, and renders inline HTML/JS.

modules.role: Plugin header, manual require_once loader, and [member_analytics_badge] shortcode
modules.health_note: No ABSPATH guard, EOL PHP 7.4 header, unescaped $_GET['badge_label'] XSS.
Hardcoded $map_webhook_secret, __return_true public PII export, CWE-89 SQLi, print_r debug leak.

modules.role: WordPress admin-ajax search and purge handlers
modules.health_note: wp_ajax_nopriv SQLi, missing nonce/capability on DELETE SQLi, unescaped $_POST XSS.

modules.role: WordPress admin settings UI and telemetry ping
modules.health_note: 'read' capability privilege escalation, missing nonce, CWE-79 XSS, unbounded @file_get_contents, raw <script>.

structure_map.boundary_assessment: Acyclic 4-file procedural split without circular includes, but completely lacks PSR-4 class boundaries, input/output sanitization layers, or WordPress authorization/nonce middleware.

execution_flows.name: Unauthenticated REST Member Export
steps: WordPress invokes map_export_all_members() with permission_callback=>'__return_true' (zero authentication).
Reads raw $_GET['role_filter'], interpolates directly into SQL LIKE query against $wpdb->users, optionally dumps rows via print_r(), and returns user_login/user_email records.

execution_flows.name: AJAX Member Search & Event Log Purge
steps: map_ajax_search_members() runs via wp_ajax_nopriv without nonce/auth and interpolates raw $_POST['term'] into $wpdb->get_results().
map_ajax_purge_logs() runs without nonce or current_user_can(), executes raw DELETE FROM wp_map_events with $_POST['category'], and echoes unescaped $_POST['category'].

execution_flows.name: Admin Settings Mutation & Telemetry Ping
steps: Any logged-in subscriber ('read' cap) can POST map_telemetry_url without nonce, persisting raw input via update_option() and firing unbounded @file_get_contents() to telemetry.example.com.
Renders unescaped $_GET['tab'] into HTML heading and form input value.

state_and_storage: WordPress MySQL database tables ($wpdb->users, wp_map_events) queried via global $wpdb without $wpdb->prepare().
WordPress wp_options key 'map_telemetry_url' mutated via update_option() without sanitization or nonce verification.
execution_flow_map.error_and_concurrency_model: Synchronous PHP request-per-process model under WordPress with silent error suppression (@file_get_contents), unstructured print_r() debug leaks, and zero defensive validation or exception handling.
